  EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE

Monday, November 30, 2020  7:00 PM  Teleconference

Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Order N-29-20, Equestrian Committee Members will be participating via
teleconference.

- Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-900-6833) from any phone, Meeting ID:
811 1226 3559, Meeting Password: 361369. (Please note you will not have the ability to speak using the call-in
option from a phone line.)

- Public correspondence may be emailed to Cynthia Morquecho, Community Services Supervisor at
cynthiam@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails received before 5:00 p.m. the night of the meeting will be forwarded
to the Committee Members for their consideration and included as part of the record.

- Members of the public may comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos”
page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/agendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an “eComment”
button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s SpeakUp page. After
you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These comments can be seen by the
public, will be considered by the Committee and become part of the record.

- Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store), by
entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 811 1226 3559, Meeting Password: 361369. Members of the public
who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the following process: After
joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at the lower portion of your
screen. The Meeting Host will send you a chat message to identify which item on the agenda you would like to
speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each agenda item are available on the City's
website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city/agendas.
